question: Should OpenClaw adopt `agents.run`, `phase`, and `log` as a permanent core QuickJS guest API and expose the associated plugin-SDK execution context?
rationale: The branch adds a new user-facing orchestration capability and an exported SDK contract; source review can identify correctness defects but cannot determine whether this is the intended permanent product boundary.

options.title: Sponsor and narrow the API
options.body: Approve the core QuickJS surface after correcting the two defects, documenting the durable contract, and adding runtime restart-recovery proof.

options.title: Keep Swarm orchestration behind a narrower seam
options.body: Request a design that avoids exporting a new general-purpose plugin-SDK execution context or permanent global names before implementation proceeds.

options.title: Pause the feature direction
options.body: Defer this public Code Mode orchestration surface until maintainers choose its ownership and compatibility model.

recommendation.title: Sponsor and narrow the API
recommendation.body: Approve the core QuickJS surface after correcting the two defects, documenting the durable contract, and adding runtime restart-recovery proof.

likelyOwner.reason: The current implementation and linked Swarm proposal are attributed to steipete, making this the best available routing candidate from the supplied history.
